question: Whose authoritative view is being conveyed to the beloved listener?
premises: The teaching is presented as a view.
The view is attributed to Śrī Vāsudeva.
The teaching has been told to the listener.
inference: The teaching conveyed is presented as the view of Śrī Vāsudeva.
plain_english: O beloved, this is the view of Śrī Vāsudeva; thus it has been told to you.
